subject: RM_TentacularPlant
departures: branches are soft, sinuous tentacle-like limbs that curl and droop, not stiff woody twigs
a distinct blue nodule caps the end of every branch, so the tips read as round blue knobs rather than leaves, buds or flowers
overall silhouette is a cluster of tentacles rising from the ground, not a leafy, rounded bush crown
the harvestable tentacular fruit is visible on the plant as tentacle-like growths, not berries or ordinary fruit
